title: Low-melting, ether-functionalised lithium salts for enhanced ion transport in molten salt electrolytes
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00246J, Communication

Yuna Matsuyama, Frederik Philippi, Taku Sudoh, David Pugh, Saki Sawayama, Kenta Fujii, Seiji Tsuzuki, Md. Sharif Hossain, Kazuhide Ueno
Ether-functionalised Li salts show low melting points, high ionic conductivity, and high Li ion transference number, enabling high-performance solvent-free molten electrolytes.
